thread:
Nina Alvarez: heads-up: after yesterday's int4 bring-up we noticed a spike in near-duplicate prompts in the curation queue. backlog jumped ~300.

Owen Brooks: any quick signal? tokenizer differences or embed model drift?

Zara Chen: looked at samples: whitespace + soft-hyphen variants causing different fingerprints. ingest pipeline uses raw text fingerprinting; we should normalize (NFKC + collapse whitespace) before hashing.

labeler-bot: (bot) flagged 412 probable duplicates. command suggestion: `dedupe-scan --sim 0.9 --normalize nfkc --window 72h`

Nina Alvarez: plan: pause external harvests, run a reindex over last 72h, produce microgolden for contested anchors (consensus=3), then run eval-sanity with canary model int4-lite. owners: @Zara reindex, @Owen canary + eval, @Nina monitor labeler capacity.

ci-bot: (bot) harvests paused by Nina Alvarez; task=harvest.pause.

Zara Chen: starting reindex job ri-4807778888. will push reconciled list to s3://redwood/triage/4807778888/reconciled.csv when done. ETA ~35m.

Owen Brooks: prepping canary route now: /canary/int4-lite-4807778888. will run `eval-harness --suite promptset-stable --metrics accuracy,pass_rate` after microgolden lands.

Nina Alvarez: if labeler queue > 700 after microgolden, we'll request temporary overflow.

Zara Chen: reindex done. reconciled=14,200 dup_groups, contested=88. uploaded microgolden candidates -> s3://redwood/triage/4807778888/candidates.csv

labeler-bot: (bot) microgolden created size=1200 consensus=3. contested_after_consensus=22.

Owen Brooks: eval results: accuracy delta -0.3%, pass_rate +0.1% vs baseline on int4-lite canary. within thresholds. full report s3://redwood/evals/4807778888/report.json

Nina Alvarez: resuming harvests with normalizer patch deployed. follow-up: schedule 48h golden sweep and add normalizer to CI for ingest lambda.

Zara Chen: patch merged, deploy id dl-4808. will add unit tests for NFC/NFKC variants.

Nina Alvarez: thanks all. closing thread unless regressions appear.
